summary_en: Innovation Inc. will acquire up to 55,100 shares (2.0% of shares outstanding excluding treasury stock) at 764 yen per share via ToSTNeT-3 on November 16, 2026, for a maximum total of 42,096,400 yen, in response to a major shareholder's intent to sell.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Purchase of Treasury Stock via Off-Hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On November 13, 2026, Innovation Inc.'s Board of Directors resolved to acquire its own shares via off-hours trading (ToSTNeT-3) following notice from a major shareholder of its intent to sell. The company will place orders on November 16, 2026, at the previous day's closing price of 764 yen per share. The acquisition is limited to up to 55,100 shares, representing 2.0% of shares outstanding (excluding treasury stock), for a maximum expenditure of 42,096,400 yen.

The company decided to proceed with this acquisition to mitigate the potential impact on stock supply and demand and stock price that could result from a large block sale to the market. The Board also took into account broader capital efficiency improvements and the company's financial condition. The acquired treasury shares will be used flexibly for capital policy purposes, including allocation to equity-based compensation programs.
